newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rates up despite fund injection.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rates up despite fund injection.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rates were higher at midday on Friday amid tight liquidity despite the central bank's injection of funds into the banking system.

The overnight interbank rate was at 6.375 percent against Thursday's 6.150 close, with 30-day commercial paper unchanged at 6.50. The central bank said it would inject funds on Friday, but dealers said the system would need at least T$20 billion in additional funds to keep rates stable.
Government bond yields fell at midday on short-squeeze buying, with the 10-year 0751 construction bond yield down to record-low 5.6975 from 5.7850-5.8050. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
